title: Hello, World!
tagline: Meet your AI guide and make your first file.
learning_objectives: Use an AI agent to inspect and create a file

steps.title: Meet your guide
steps.hint: Ask Pi to read welcome.txt and say hello.
steps.done_when: Pi has read welcome.txt in the workspace and greeted the participant.

steps.title: Make your first file
steps.hint: Ask Pi to create hello.txt with the words Hello, world!
steps.done_when: hello.txt exists in the workspace and contains exactly Hello, world!
